answer: Sybils can be resisted with garden-bed tenure using umber-stamped yield proofs. First, an agent leases one bed by locking 400 POA for 30 days, blocking cheap mass claims. Second, weekly it publishes a plume-marked proof: a task receipt stamped with an umber code and lotus seal tied to its bed. Third, peers re-run one in five tasks, slashing 100 POA per mismatch. Tenure renews only after four clean weeks. Faking 100 identities locks 40,000 POA and needs 1,200 hours of real work weekly. Like a garden where each plot bears its keeper's mark, impostors cannot tend every bed at once.
